build_aeslc_dataset: build the Aeslc dataset builder using tfds.builder_cls('aeslc') to load the email summarization dataset
create_aeslc_dataset: create an Aeslc dataset instance by calling the lazy Aeslc builder with a data directory
test_aeslc_as_dataset: test the Aeslc builder by calling as_dataset to get a tf.data.Dataset for training
run_aeslc_download: run download_and_prepare on the Aeslc builder to download and prepare the dataset
review_aeslc_info: review the Aeslc builder info to inspect dataset features, splits, and version metadata
